name: Skewness-Weighted Bond Tilt + 8% Vol Target
description: Skewness-weighted tilt applied to the fixed-income universe (US Treasuries, USD-hedged global aggregate, global high yield, EUR govt bonds, India INR govt bonds), reducing weight on bonds with left-skewed return distributions (tail/crash risk proxy), then scales to 8% annualised volatility target. Captures tail-risk management within a fixed-income sleeve.
